thisIsNotAVerdict: A builder verdict is not a verdict. These counters are the builder contract's own obligation, computed with scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs over this family's field map, byte proof, rendered artifacts and participant-instructions.md. An independent verification lane that did not build this packet decides whether it passes, and PASS_COMPLETE additionally requires a hash-bound RASTER_PASS.
